_about: energy1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/energy1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

en.swat.set._orig: sighting the shot: the near forearm held out low in front of him, the elbow tucked at the ribs, the plate turned up, the other hand back at the chest

en.swat.chop._orig: the swat: the elbow a hinge at the ribs and the forearm swung up through the line of the shot in one chop, the hips turning with it, the fist closed, the plate meeting the shot and sending it wild

en.swat.recover._orig: dropping back to guard, the arm coming down, the eyes following the shot

en.mine.reach._orig: bringing the near hand out and down in front of him, the eyes on it, the knees giving a little; the other hand open at shoulder height for balance

en.mine.lay._orig: the hand low and a little ahead, the palm down, setting the plate where it hangs; the head bowed over it

en.mine.rise._orig: standing up out of it, the hand coming back, a glance at the plate

en.spray.kick._orig: the bolt leaving: the lead arm kicked up a little and the shoulder rocking back with it, the rear hand thrown out wide for balance

en.spray.settle._orig: back on the line: the lead arm level and out, the loose clawed hand aimed along it, the feet planted wide, the head down along the arm
